captions.formal: A multi-lane urban street carries continuous two-way traffic in a daytime time-lapse sequence. Cars in white, black, silver, and red, together with a red and white bus, flow along the roadway. The street is bordered by trees with yellow and green autumn foliage, with densely packed apartment buildings and commercial structures rising behind them. A partially legible sign on a left-side building reads 'KOREA MEDIA ENGRAVE.' The motion-blurred vehicles contrast with the static warm-lit cityscape.
captions.sarcastic: A truly electrifying spectacle unfolds: hundreds of metal boxes, including one brave red and white bus, hurtle down a tree-lined avenue at the breathtaking speed of a time-lapse blur, framed by golden autumn leaves and a building proudly announcing 'KOREA MEDIA ENGRAVE' to absolutely no one in particular.
captions.humorous_tech: The city's traffic stack is running a full production merge with zero rate-limiting and absolutely no consensus, as hundreds of cars and one overeager red bus all push commits to the same multi-lane branch at once while the autumn trees silently watch the incident unfold in prod.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A red and white bus and roughly a hundred cars throw themselves down a wide city avenue like everyone is late for the exact same meeting, while the autumn trees lining the street stand perfectly still, clearly the only ones in the neighborhood with their priorities in order.

captions.formal: A small orange tabby kitten with light fur, faint darker stripes, and a pink nose sits beneath green leafy bushes in a sunlit garden, dappled shadows falling across the dirt ground. The kitten walks slowly forward out of the foliage, tail held upright, and approaches the camera with steady eye contact until its face and front paws fill the frame.
captions.sarcastic: A lone orange kitten emerges from the undergrowth with the heroic gravity of a creature who has absolutely never been late for anything in its entire life, advancing across bare dirt toward the lens like a furry diplomat arriving to deliver terms the camera did not agree to, tail raised in what can only be described as a formal declaration of intent.
captions.humorous_tech: A single orange tabby deploys straight from the garden bushes with no rollback plan and zero staging, advancing across the dirt toward the camera like a long-running process that simply refuses to time out, tail held high as it pushes to main with the quiet confidence of a commit nobody is going to review.
captions.humorous_non_tech: One tiny orange kitten steps out from under the bushes with the quiet authority of a creature who has somewhere extremely important to be, crosses a patch of bare dirt like it owns every square inch, and walks straight toward the camera as if the whole garden has been waiting for him to arrive.

captions.formal: A young Black woman with her dark hair styled in a high bun sits at a white desk in a brightly lit, modern open-plan office. She wears a beige button-up overshirt, a bright orange ribbed top, a silver cross necklace, and small stud earrings, with bright pink fingernails. Facing a large black computer monitor, she rests her hands on the desk before moving them to type on a keyboard just out of view, occasionally pausing to look intently at the screen. A black wired mouse and tangled black cables rest on the desk. The setting features distinctive large circular ceiling lights, glass partitions, and white desks.
captions.sarcastic: A young woman sits in a sleek, sunlit office, facing a large black monitor with the rapt intensity of someone about to crack the Da Vinci code. She pauses, stares, types a few quiet keystrokes on an invisible keyboard, then pauses again to stare some more, all while a tangle of loose black cables lurks inches from her bright pink fingernails like a coiled serpent nobody has bothered to defeat.
captions.humorous_tech: A junior developer stares down a massive black monitor with zero stack trace and zero error message, just vibes. She types into the void, pauses to re-read her own work like a git diff she is not sure she wants to merge, and keeps pushing commits into production while a nest of unmanaged cables quietly grows into a dependency no one will ever refactor.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A young woman sits at her desk with the quiet intensity of someone who has definitely not lost her place. Her bright pink fingernails hover over the keyboard, chasing thoughts that keep slipping away the moment she looks up. She pauses, stares at the monitor like it owes her an explanation, then dives back in, shoulders squared against the tangled cables plotting their escape. Somewhere between the second and third sentence, the whole office holds its breath, waiting for her to finally hit save.

captions.formal: An elevated, wide-angle view captures continuous daytime traffic along a multi-lane city street. White, black, silver, and red cars, alongside a red bus, travel in both directions across grey asphalt marked with white and yellow lane dividers. The road is bordered by tall, light-colored apartment buildings and a row of trees displaying yellow autumn foliage. A partially legible sign reading "KOREA MEDIA ENGRAVE" is visible on the left. The time-lapse sequence blurs the moving vehicles while the stationary surroundings remain in sharp focus.
captions.sarcastic: A truly electrifying spectacle unfolds on a sunlit boulevard, where hundreds of motorists engage in the daring, high-stakes sport of inching forward in two directions at once. A bold red bus joins the fray, presumably because watching paint dry was too thrilling. The trees, dressed in their finest yellow, watch impassively, having long since given up trying to offer shade to anyone actually moving.
captions.humorous_tech: Rush hour hits prod with a massive unhandled exception: hundreds of cars and one rogue red bus all hit the same multi-lane endpoint with no rate limiting in sight, causing severe latency across the entire city network. The autumn trees on the median are just bystanders wondering why nobody deployed a proper traffic-shaping config before this rollout went live.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Hundreds of drivers pour down a wide city avenue in a frantic morning stampede, each one absolutely certain that their lane is the secret shortcut. A red bus bulldozes into the mix like a substitute teacher who just found the parking lot, while the bright yellow trees overhead silently judge the whole gridlocked parade.

captions.formal: A small orange tabby kitten with light fur, faint darker stripes, a pink nose, and large attentive eyes sits beneath a canopy of green leafy bushes and thin brown branches in an outdoor setting. The ground is covered with dry leaves and twigs. The kitten stands and walks forward in cautious steps toward the camera, its tail held upright, advancing steadily through the dappled natural light until it is very near the lens.
captions.sarcastic: A single orange kitten sits under a bush, staring into the camera with the grave intensity of a creature about to deliver a keynote address, then rises and takes a few cautious steps over some leaves as though crossing a frozen lake full of piranhas, tail held high like a tiny flag of conquest, advancing all the way to the lens on what is plainly the most important journey of its entire morning.
captions.humorous_tech: A single orange kitten ships straight from the garden canopy into a leaf-covered staging branch with no rollback plan, sitting still for a few seconds before standing up and slowly walking toward the camera like a long-running process that refuses to time out, tail held high as a green build that just will not fail.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A tiny orange kitten sits under a bush with the quiet authority of a creature who has somewhere extremely important to be, then stands up and walks forward over the dry leaves one careful step at a time, tail straight up like a flag, marching toward the camera with the full seriousness of someone who absolutely intends to be taken seriously.

captions.formal: A young Black woman with dark hair in a high bun sits at a white desk in a brightly lit, modern open-plan office. She wears a beige button-up overshirt, a bright orange ribbed top, a silver cross necklace, small stud earrings, and bright pink fingernails. Facing a large black computer monitor with a black wired mouse to her left, she speaks during a video call, gestures with her hands, and then reaches down to untangle the black cables positioned in front of her keyboard.
captions.sarcastic: A young professional sits at her desk, engaged in a video call, gesturing with the practiced enthusiasm of someone who has definitely been told to smile more, before finally turning her attention to the tangled black cables in front of her keyboard, because nothing says a productive workday quite like performing a live tech support session on your own desk.
captions.humorous_tech: A remote worker is mid-standup on a video call when she hits a critical production incident: the spaghetti cabling under her keyboard has reached an unrecoverable merge conflict. She drops out of the meeting to refactor the cables by hand, because no amount of legacy cable management can survive this much entropy.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A young woman sits at her desk chatting animatedly to someone on her monitor, gesturing like a conductor running an orchestra of one, until she finally looks down and discovers the real boss of the morning: a hopeless knot of black cables waiting patiently by her keyboard, daring her to try.

captions.formal: An elevated, wide-angle view captures steady vehicular traffic along a multi-lane, divided city street bathed in warm, golden daylight. Cars of white, black, silver, and red travel in both directions past tall trees displaying yellow autumn foliage. A red double-decker bus advances through the right lanes, while high-rise apartment and commercial buildings fill the background skyline behind a partially legible sign reading KOREA MEDIA ENGRAVE.
captions.sarcastic: A truly breathtaking spectacle unfolds as several hundred drivers inch down a wide city boulevard under a canopy of yellow autumn leaves, each one absolutely certain that their particular lane is the masterwork of urban navigation. A red double-decker bus glides forward with the quiet confidence of a vehicle that has never once questioned its life choices, while the surrounding high-rises stand by, offering nothing.
captions.humorous_tech: The city's morning commute attempts a massive distributed merge into the main boulevard with zero consensus algorithm and visibly high latency, every car and one ambitious red double-decker bus pushing the same branch at once while the autumn trees overhead silently watch the production incident unfold in real time.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Several hundred drivers glide down a wide city street under a canopy of golden autumn leaves, each one alone in their little metal bubble and quietly convinced that this lane, this one, is the genius move, while a red double-decker bus rolls forward like it owns the whole boulevard and the surrounding high-rises politely pretend not to notice.

captions.formal: An orange tabby kitten with faint darker stripes and a pink nose sits beneath sunlit green foliage in a garden setting, casting dappled shadows across the dry dirt ground. The kitten looks directly toward the camera before advancing slowly along the dirt path with deliberate, cautious steps. Its tail rises upright behind it as it moves closer through the warm, sun-dappled surroundings.
captions.sarcastic: Against a breathtaking backdrop of dirt and one shrub, a single orange kitten embarks on what can only be described as a legendary expedition across roughly six feet of garden, each cautious pawstep carrying the weight of a creature who has definitely never been told to come inside before.
captions.humorous_tech: The orange tabby kitten pushes its first commit directly from the foliage branch into the dirt-path production environment with zero code review, pausing mid-deployment to sniff a suspicious leaf flagged as a critical regression, then advancing toward the camera like a legacy process that refuses to be deprecated.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A small orange kitten steps out from under a bush with the absolute seriousness of someone late for a meeting they cannot afford to miss, each careful paw placed on the dirt like it is personally responsible for the outcome, tail held high as if to prove, once and for all, that it knows exactly where it is going.

captions.formal: A young Black woman with dark hair in a high bun sits at a white desk in a brightly lit modern office, wearing a beige button-up overshirt over a bright orange ribbed top, accessorized with a silver cross necklace and small stud earrings. She faces a large black computer monitor with a black wired mouse positioned to her left and a potted green plant visible in the background. Throughout the sequence, she actively types on a white keyboard, her hands moving rhythmically as she focuses intently on the screen with a concentrated expression.
captions.sarcastic: A young woman in a beige overshirt and bright orange top sits at a pristine white desk beneath those enormous circular ceiling lights, hammering away at a white keyboard with the quiet, focused intensity of someone who has definitely not just reread the same email seven times. Her expression remains locked in that grave concentration reserved for tasks of earth-shattering importance, while a potted plant in the background silently bears witness to the entire ordeal.
captions.humorous_tech: A junior dev sits at her desk pushing a fresh commit straight to main with no code review and no staging environment, her fingers hammering the keyboard like she's racing a CI pipeline that is definitely going to fail. The expression on her face says she is deep in a flow state; the three unread Slack messages and the untouched Jira ticket say she is deep in something else entirely, while the potted plant quietly judges her merge strategy.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A young woman settles at a pristine white desk beneath those enormous glowing ceiling circles, fully prepared to tackle the day with quiet, focused determination. She types with the steady rhythm of someone who absolutely knows what she is doing, her face locked in that serious concentration reserved for tasks of truly enormous importance, while a small green plant in the background looks on, mildly impressed by the whole performance.

Numerous vehicles, including white, black, silver, and red cars alongside a red double-decker bus, travel in both directions along the busy thoroughfare. Tall apartment buildings and trees with yellow autumn foliage line the route. A partially legible sign reads "KOREA MEDIA ENGRAVE." Continuous traffic flows past stationary surroundings in a time-lapse sequence.
captions.sarcastic: Nothing says urban vitality quite like a hundred metal boxes hurtling down a tree-lined avenue in both directions at once, all in a desperate race to sit in the exact same traffic jam, while a single red double-decker bus lumbers through the chaos like it has somewhere genuinely important to be and the rest of us are merely background scenery.
captions.humorous_tech: City traffic attempts a massive distributed merge into the main thoroughfare with zero consensus algorithm and catastrophic latency, hundreds of cars and one ambitious red bus all pushing to commit to the same branch at once while the autumn trees overhead silently watch the production incident unfold in real-time.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Hundreds of drivers barrel down a golden-lit avenue in autumn, each one locked inside their own little metal bubble and privately convinced that today, finally, they have picked the correct lane, while a red double-decker bus muscles through the whole mess looking like it has an appointment the rest of them have never even heard about.

captions.formal: An orange tabby kitten with faint darker stripes, a pink nose, and large dark eyes sits motionless on bare dirt in a sunlit outdoor area framed by green bushes and thin branches. The kitten rises and walks forward step-by-step toward the camera, its tail held upright, as dappled sunlight filters through the foliage.
captions.sarcastic: A single orange tabby kitten sits on bare dirt, staring down the camera with the gravity of a creature about to deliver a keynote address on absolutely nothing. It then rises and walks forward one deliberate paw at a time, tail raised, advancing on the lens as if to inspect whether the operator is even qualified to be here.
captions.humorous_tech: The orange tabby kitten stages up from idle on the bare-dirt server, blinking through one cold-start stare before initiating a slow, deliberate forward walk toward the camera with its tail held high like a healthy heartbeat. No rollback plan, no retries, just one tiny process advancing on the lens with the confidence of a legacy script that has never once crashed.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A small orange kitten sits on a patch of dirt, fixing the camera with a look that says it has already taken your measure and found you wanting. It then stands and walks forward one careful step at a time, tail up, closing the distance like a tiny landlord coming to discuss the rent.

captions.formal: A young Black woman with dark hair in a high bun sits at a white desk in a brightly lit modern office during daytime. She wears a beige button-up overshirt, an orange ribbed top, a silver cross necklace, and stud earrings. Facing a large black monitor, she types on a white keyboard, occasionally pausing to look closely at the display before resuming. A black mouse and tangled cables rest on the desk.
captions.sarcastic: A young woman sits in a sun-drenched office, her pink fingernails hovering over a white keyboard as she stares down a black monitor like it owes her a personal explanation. Tangled cables sprawl across the desk, and yet here she is, calmly typing as though productivity itself depends on her willingness to keep pretending they aren't a fire hazard.
captions.humorous_tech: A developer stares down a black monitor like it just returned a 500 on her biggest commit, her pink fingernails hammering a white keyboard in a furious attempt to debug whatever legacy spaghetti she inherited. The tangled cables on the desk suggest someone skipped the last three sprints of cable management, and yet the deploy must ship, so the typing continues.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A woman sits at her desk with the quiet intensity of someone who has accepted that the tangled cables are simply part of her personality now. Her pink fingernails tap the keyboard with purpose, she leans in to read the monitor, then leans back, then leans in again, locked in the ancient office ritual of pretending one more glance will finally make sense of everything.
